71e28936f0d54a5a451690483e86ac2562f671f7.summary: Press statement from the Illinois Attorney General's office, dated April 13, 2021. The office said its network had been compromised, discovered in the early hours of a Saturday. Staff and investigators were working with federal law enforcement to assess the extent of the compromise. The investigation was ongoing and further information was promised later. The report names no attacker, tools, techniques or CVEs.

dates.what: Attorney General's office announced its network had been compromised

subject.name: Illinois Attorney General's office network compromise

hedges: The investigation into the extent to which the Attorney General's office's network was compromised is ongoing.
Additional information will be made available at a later date.

7113577e8a66743a21b3d2fb74df94e8df65494d.summary: Malpedia entry for POWERSTATS, a PowerShell backdoor also called Valyria, which the entry lists under the MuddyWater actor. It can disable Microsoft Office Protected View, fingerprint the victim and receive commands. The entry lists external references dated 2017 to 2023 and says there is no YARA signature yet.
